meaning:
ἀντιλογία, -ας ἡ
(ἀντιλέγω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;]
gain-saying, strife (the latter sense being found in π.; see MM, VGT, see word; cf. Field, Notes, 106): Heb.6:16 7:7 12:3, Ju 11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
